dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi! Welcome to our café! What can I get you?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! ˈwɛlkəm tə aʊər kæˈfeɪ! ˈwʌt kən aɪ ˈɡɛt juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I get an iced latte, please?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈɡɛt ən ˈaɪst ˈlɑːteɪ, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Can I get a hot cocoa?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈɡɛt ə ˈhɑːt ˈkoʊkoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. An iced latte and a hot cocoa.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ən ˈaɪst ˈlɑːteɪ ənd ə ˈhɑːt ˈkoʊkoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, and a mango smoothie, too, please!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ənd ə ˈmæŋɡoʊ ˈsmuːði, ˈtuː, ˈpliːz!
